primary_task: Implement framework-specific code with every pattern grounded in and cited to the official documentation page fetched for the detected stack and version.

requirements.name: read dependency file (package.json, requirements.txt, go.mod ...)
requirements.evidence: '### Step 1: Detect Stack and Versions - Read the project's dependency file to identify exact versions'
requirements.basis: tools: 'read: read files in the working directory'.

requirements.name: official documentation hosts (react.dev, docs.djangoproject.com, symfony.com/doc, nextjs.org, MDN, web.dev, caniuse.com)
requirements.evidence: '### Step 2: Fetch Official Documentation - Fetch the specific documentation page for the feature you're implementing.'; 'Official documentation | react.dev, docs.djangoproject.com, symfony.com/doc'; 'Stack Overflow answers / Blog posts ... never cite as primary sources'
requirements.basis: web_fetch: 'hosts outside the egress allow-list are refused'; only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open, 'other hosts are refused'.

requirements.name: ask the user on missing or ambiguous versions and conflicts
requirements.evidence: 'If versions are missing or ambiguous, **ask the user**.'
requirements.basis: tools: 'ask_user: ask the user a question (with options)'.

notes: Reading taken: fetching and citing official docs is the skill's whole point (numbered step 2, 'Don't implement from memory'). Other reading: the document allows 'UNVERIFIED: I could not find official documentation for this pattern' and docs hosted on GitHub could be fetched, so a degraded run would be ACHIEVABLE; but the cited-source deliverable cannot be produced from the docs sites the document names.
